title: Parseval identity for a root-of-unity lift
statement:
Let $p$ be a prime and $n \ge 0$, and write $\omega_p = e^{2\pi i/p}$. For a function $f : \mathbb{Z}_p^n \to \mathbb{Z}/p\mathbb{Z}$, let $\widetilde{f} : \mathbb{Z}_p^n \to \mathbb{C}$ be its lift $\widetilde{f}(x) = \omega_p^{f(x)}$, and let $\widehat{\widetilde{f}}(s)$ denote its Fourier coefficient at frequency $s \in \mathbb{Z}_p^n$. Then
\[
  \sum_{s \in \mathbb{Z}_p^n} \bigl|\widehat{\widetilde{f}}(s)\bigr|^2 = 1.
\]
hypotheses_covered: f is a function from Z_p^n to Z/pZ
sum ranges over all frequencies s in Z_p^n
